info.description: MB-755 contract-first only. All operations planned. Journal/AI owns voice; Care owns independent dual consent; Consultation remains entitlement authority. Does not activate runtime, replace text APIs or authorize joining specialist rooms. MB-782 additive Web preview and exact admitted Agent identity amendment; existing policy unchanged.

get.description: Current owner-sourced capability, not authority to connect. Resolve BOTH Care consents, Consultation current entitlement, independent voice quota and provider readiness. Uncertainty never maps to ELIGIBLE. No client package/policy/clock authority.

post.description: USER only. Resolve current subject, both consents and entitlement before atomic Mongo admission. Reserve user1/global2 and finite session+seconds before any room/dispatch effect. Existing attempt conflict SESSION_LIMIT; duplicate same key reuses logical session. Snapshot day/route/deadline; no text quota or financial writes.

post.description: NEW prerequisite owner API, not the existing user-bearer consent read. Dedicated Journal-only service identity/token, purpose AI_COMPANION_VOICE, allowlisted caller, verified exact owner+session binding and current owner facts; no user JWT or grant replication. Both independent decisions must be current and granted. Request deadline2s; fail closed on unknown/stale decisions; no caching. Runtime Care work is a prerequisite for MB-756.

post.description: NEW narrow read-only prerequisite for service-authenticated per-turn checks without storing/forwarding user JWT. Dedicated Journal-only credential, exact session-owned user reference and purpose; Consultation resolves current entitlement. DEFAULT_FREE must be FREE; paid/DEMO PLUS/PREMIUM require validUntil strictly later than checkedAt/current server time. Expired/unknown/inconsistent responses deny voice, never fail open. Preserve existing /internal/v1/entitlements/current and all financial/credit behavior. No mutable shadow entitlement or side effect. Deadline2s; no cache.

post.description: Dedicated worker credential+exact trusted explicit dispatch. Journal resolves user from admitted session; worker cannot select user/package/model. Exactly one fenced claimed attempt; duplicate dispatch cannot join or reserve twice. No user JWT, transcript/context or provider secret in dispatch metadata.

Cache-Control.description: Required on success and errors. Never cache capabilities, connection tokens, transcripts or owner decisions.

post.description: Accept worker-origin MEDIA_READY/PLAYBACK_STARTED/INTERRUPTED/HEARTBEAT/FINISHED only, bound to claimed attempt/lease and increasing worker sequence. Schema rejects backend-only DISPATCH/LEASE_RENEWED/STOP. Successful authorized heartbeat returns CONTINUE with a Journal-issued LEASE_RENEWED envelope; observed revocation, stop or terminal acknowledgement returns STOP with its exact reason and separately sequenced backend envelope, never a fresh live lease. Fresh owner checks before lease renewal; lease10s/renew5s; stop processing and purge context at expiry. Independent authenticated room removal/teardown provides the media cutoff; expiry alone cannot free a global permit. Server state intervals determine usage; worker cannot submit billed seconds.

Cache-Control.description: Required on success and errors. Never cache capabilities, connection tokens, transcripts or owner decisions.

post.description: Ephemeral final vi-VN STT only; validate trimmed nonempty text, language, finality, order, attempt/lease and unique turn. Freshly verify BOTH consent streams, Consultation entitlement, remaining independent voice usage and current approved pinned Bedrock route BEFORE EVERY generation and before publication. Do not call persisted text send or consume text answers. Dedicated service identity; no client/worker user selection. RAM-only recent4turnpairs/2000tokens; transcript2000chars/reply1000chars; no transcript/prompt/provider output in idempotency snapshots/logs/traces. In-memory replay returns exact reply only during live lease; after context loss, fail stale rather than regenerate/charge again. Cancel/discard late responses after stop/withdrawal/lease expiry. No provider fallback, no Care/financial/safety mutation.

VoiceWorkerToken.name: X-MentalBridge-Voice-Worker-Token
VoiceWorkerToken.description: Dedicated secret worker identity held only in worker/Journal. Not a user token, room metadata or general internal credential. Bind exact admitted dispatch+attempt+lease in owner.

JournalVoiceCareToken.name: X-MentalBridge-Voice-Care-Token
JournalVoiceCareToken.description: Unique Journal-to-Care current voice authorization credential; allowlist exact caller/purpose. Different from worker and Consultation credentials.

JournalVoiceEntitlementToken.name: X-MentalBridge-Voice-Entitlement-Token
JournalVoiceEntitlementToken.description: Unique Journal-to-Consultation read-only voice entitlement credential; no financial write authority.

maxSessionSeconds.description: Current package policy ceiling in seconds. Not an admission or reservation.

availableSessionSeconds.description: Display-only server-derived duration when ELIGIBLE, positive and at most min(maxSessionSeconds, unreserved daily remainingSeconds); additional operational caps or a remaining operational window may reduce it further. Zero otherwise. Reauthorize and admit atomically on POST; never derive a deadline from this snapshot.

participantToken.description: Ephemeral owner-scoped media credential; never log, persist or place in metadata.

roomName.description: Exact admitted room for this connection. Compare the connected SDK room name before reading Agent hints.

agentIdentity.description: Exact admitted Agent attempt identity. Require ParticipantKind.AGENT in roomName; never select a participant from its attributes.
